svg.title: Planar Poiseuille and moving-wall profiles
svg.desc: Channel gap 2 mm,viscosity 0.004 Pa s,driving pressure gradient 100 Pa/m. Stationary-wall center speed 12.5 mm/s. A 20 mm/s upper-wall condition adds a linear Couette contribution. This is an exact reduced steady benchmark.
